name: Cuban Beef Picadillo with Rice

components.name: Picadillo
steps: Brown minced beef in a hot nonstick or lightly oiled sauté pan. Drain excess rendered fat if necessary.
Add onion, pepper, garlic and fresh chopped tomato; soften over medium heat.
Stir in cumin, bay leaves, chopped olives and olive brine, followed by tomato sauce and a splash of water.
Cover and cook on low for 15–20 minutes to develop the sauce; remove bay leaves.

components.name: Rice
steps: Rinse and cook rice using the correct package ratio. Cool promptly when done.
Divide beef and rice into six meals. Keep the grains and saucy mince as separate components.
Reheat until steaming hot and add fresh herbs at serving time.
